pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of adding positions within 15 minutes of a prior stopped order; scaling is only permitted when existing open positions show a minimum unrealized profit of +$10.00.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory order block confirmation combined with volume delta exhaustion via an EMA slope alignment check on the 5-minute chart prior to execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing or partial scaling the moment a trade hits +$10.00 profit to completely eradicate floating profit evaporation.
